shift_pattern: Day 8AM-5PM or night 8PM-5AM, 6 days a week

screening_questions.text: Are you able to lift up to 15 kilos repeatedly through a shift?
screening_questions.why_it_matters: Lifting is a core physical requirement of the role.

screening_questions.text: Would you prefer the day shift or the night shift?
screening_questions.why_it_matters: We are staffing both shifts and night carries an allowance.

screening_questions.text: Can you reach our Chakan facility, or one of the Chakan or Bhosari shuttle pickup points?
screening_questions.why_it_matters: Reliable travel to site is essential for shift work.

screening_questions.text: How many years of warehouse work have you done, if any?
screening_questions.why_it_matters: Experience is preferred though we train freshers.

screening_questions.text: Are you comfortable standing and walking for a full shift?
screening_questions.why_it_matters: The role is on foot for the whole shift.

facts_the_agent_may_state: The role is warehouse picker and packer at our fulfilment centre in Chakan, Pune.
Pay is Rs 16,000 to Rs 21,000 per month based on shift and experience.
The night shift carries an additional allowance of Rs 3,000 per month.
Overtime is paid at 1.5 times the hourly rate.
Salary is credited by the 7th of each month.
Shifts are day 8 AM to 5 PM or night 8 PM to 5 AM, six days a week.
Safety shoes and gloves are provided.
A subsidised canteen meal is provided each shift.
A free shuttle runs from Chakan and Bhosari pickup points.
The work involves picking with a handheld scanner, packing cartons and lifting up to 15 kg.
Freshers are trained; prior warehouse experience is preferred but not required.
